title: AX report
description: A structured Agent Experience friction report or feature request.

tool.description: The tool the report is about, e.g. 'anchor'.

session_id.description: Groups every finding from one AX session / goal. Shared across the batch and used as a filename segment so the whole run is greppable.

goal.description: The goal the subject was pursuing when this friction surfaced (one line).

surface.description: The specific command / MCP tool / endpoint, e.g. 'anchor check --probe'.

task.description: What the agent was trying to do.

expected.description: What the tool's surface led the agent to expect. Required for friction.

actual.description: What actually happened. Required for friction.

workaround.description: What the agent did instead, or null if blocked.

suggestion.description: Proposed fix, or the body of a feature_request.

session_hint.description: Optional pointer back to the session or transcript.
